title: 014 一剑枯雪
content_zh:
“我说无心和尚，怎么跟着你走到哪，都能遇见这么多一等一的高手？而且好像都一副要打架的样子？”萧瑟的语气中几乎透露出绝望了。
“一等一的高手？打架？”雷无桀望着院中的那些人，倒是一副跃跃欲试的样子
萧瑟抚额：“雷门好歹也是江湖大世家，怎么就养出你这么个白痴……”
“谁来了？”轿中之人背对着他们，只听到有人在说话，却看不到他们，便出声询问。
“师父，是他们。和探子说的一样，除了那个和尚，还有那两个穿着红衣和狐裘的少年。”灵均答道。
“哦。”轿中之人倒也没有流露出惊讶，只是轻声应道。
“萧瑟，你看这是什么情况？”雷无桀发现氛围有些异样，便问萧瑟。
“很明显，之前轿子这边这伙人和和尚这伙人在打，然后打到一半，我们来了。”萧瑟一直打量着那顶轿子，漫不经心地说着。
“然后呢？”雷无桀依然困惑。
“然后他们发现，哇，不用打了，该来的大鱼已经来了！”萧瑟没好气地说。
“大鱼？是指我们？”雷无桀恍然大悟。
“不！”萧瑟一把拉住雷无桀，跃到了边上远远地躲开了无心，“大鱼只是他！”
无心笑着振了振衣袖，倒不似一个吃斋事佛的和尚，更像是一个准备粉墨登场的戏子：“劳烦大内掌香大监不远千里来找我这个小和尚，真是荣幸啊！”
两名护寺武僧闻言大惊，同时看向方丈，但那老和尚依然还是在那摇头。长须和尚倒是并不惊讶，只是愣愣地望着无心。
“果然是他……”萧瑟此时眉头微皱。
“掌香大监是谁？”熟知江湖各类英雄故事的雷无桀此时却一头雾水。
“北离皇帝每年祭祀的时候，身后都会站着四个太监，其中一个持着镇国宝剑，一个拿着传国玉玺，一个手持律法典籍，最后一个捧着青花香炉，这四个大监加上与皇帝一同长大的伴读太监，合称五大监。掌剑太监负责皇宫守卫，掌印太监协助处理公文，掌册太监负责监管藏书楼典籍，而掌香太监则是本朝新设，负责监管皇家佛寺。每个人都握有巨大的权力，并且都是一等一的大内高手。”萧瑟说道。
“萧兄真是博学啊！”雷无桀难得真挚地喊了声萧兄。
“我可是雪落山庄的老板，江湖琐碎，庙堂高阁，可没有我不知道的。”萧瑟流露出几分得意。
“那你说皇帝身边的人，跑这么远来做什么？”雷无桀问。

“掌香太监名义上只是监管皇家佛寺，可是主管佛教、道教事务的鸿胪寺卿之位空悬多年，这几年一直由他代为兼任，天下佛寺，莫不在他的监管之下。只是没想到这个和尚竟然这么重要，连掌香太监都不远千里奔赴来抓他。看来他的身份绝不仅仅是忘忧的弟子那么简单。”萧瑟和雷无桀说着话的时候，轿子的人终于动了，即便是面对长须和尚那无上威势的一刀的时候，轿中人都没有动，可是听到无心的话，他终于动了。他一动，站在轿子右边的大汉也动了，他立刻匍匐在地，将背刚刚隆起，轿中人穿着一双紫靴，踩着那壮汉的背从轿子上走了下来。
萧瑟冷冷地哼了一声。
“你哼什么……”雷无桀望了那轿中人一眼，却顿时明了了，萧瑟不管比什么都不愿输，尤其是不愿意输这相貌，可这轿中人，却好看的有些过分了！面如冠玉，风度卓越，一双丹凤眼的眸子带着些说不出的妩媚，虽然双鬓的两片斑白还是暴露了他的年纪，但却更给他增添了几分仙气，他一手拿着一串细长的佛珠，修长的手指轻轻地拨动着，一手扶着腰间的一把长剑，若即若离地似乎准备拔剑。
“大监。”无心双手合十，微微垂首行礼。
“别叫我大监，大监可是宫里那位才能叫的。”那人轻轻笑道，幽幽地指了下天。
“瑾仙公公。”无心换了称呼，依旧恭恭敬敬。
可这瑾仙公公却依然不买账，笑着摇摇头：“你这么恭敬，我倒是不习惯了。那年和我把酒言欢的白衣邪僧哪去了？”
“把酒言欢？”萧瑟和雷无桀对视了一眼，难怪这无心看见那醉酒和尚就大步追上，敢情是遇到了同道中人啊。
“那时你来找我是喝酒，这次你是来找我可是抓我。可不一样。”无心笑着，眸子森冷。
“宫里那个人的命令我不能不听，但是保你这条命，我还是能做到的。”瑾仙公公一步步地往前走着。
“就走到那儿吧。”无心忽然说道。
瑾仙公公停住了脚步，饶有趣味地望向无心。
“这一路上雪月城、九龙寺、鸿胪寺甚至天外天都来找我，他们中的每一个都说不会杀我。所以你这个条件似乎并不特别。”无心说道。
“天外天的人见过你了？”瑾仙公公神色微微一动。
“白发仙，紫衣侯。都是久违的人。”无心淡淡地说。
“你没跟他们走？”瑾仙公公的手依然地触过剑柄。
“我还有心愿未了。”无心的目光有意无意地望向瑾仙公公的身后。
“看来，我选择在这里等你，并没有错。”瑾仙公公笑道。
“你的选择没有错，但你一定猜错了我的来意。”无心说。
“哦？你不是来杀他的？”瑾仙公公转身望了一眼那个长须和尚。

“佛陀慈悲，出家人可不能妄动杀念。”无心说得坦然。
“我不想与你动手。”瑾仙公公叹了口气。
“我也不想。天下皆知五大监里掌香大监武功排名第二，比掌剑大监都要尤胜一筹。”无心说。
“但是你刚刚有一句话说错了。”
“无心愚昧，敢问是哪一句？”
“雪月城、九龙寺、天外天，我和他们是不同的，若是这一次带不走你。那么我就会毫不犹豫地杀掉你！”瑾仙公公的手终于稳稳地按在了剑柄之上。
“好！”无心一跃而起，双袖如飞翼展开，长袍飞舞，犹若神人，“请公公出剑！”
瑾仙公公终于拔出了他的剑，他拔出剑的那一刻，寺庙里的每一个人都感觉到了一种刺骨的寒意。那是一柄冒着霜气的剑，剑锋所指之处，都瞬间凝结！
“我记起来了！我听说过这个人，他是……”雷无桀突然大声喊了出来。是的，他听说过的。他听过这个人，这个人不仅是庙堂之上的人物，他在江湖上也曾经很有名！
“右手杀生，一剑既出，风雪枯萎。左手慈悲，佛珠轻捻，魄灭魂飞。”萧瑟点头说道，“当年还是少年的五大监曾奉师命离开皇宫闯荡江湖，每个人都在江湖中赫赫有名。是的，你的确听说过他。他就是风雪剑沈静舟！”
content_en:
"I said, Monk Wu Xin, why do I meet so many first-class masters wherever I follow you? And they all seem to be ready to fight?" Xiao Se's tone almost revealed despair.
"First-rate master? Fight?" Lei Wujie looked at the people in the courtyard, looking eager to try.
Xiao Se stroked his forehead: "Thunder Gate is also a famous family, how could it raise an idiot like you..."
"Who is here?" The person in the sedan asked with his back to them. He could only hear someone talking but couldn't see them.
"Master, it's them. Just as the spies said, in addition to the monk, there are also the two young men wearing red clothes and fox fur." ​​Ling Jun replied.
"Oh." The person in the sedan did not show any surprise, but responded softly.
"Xiao Se, what do you think this is?" Lei Wujie noticed that the atmosphere was a little strange, so he asked Xiao Se.
"Obviously, the group on the sedan side and the monk group were fighting before, and then in the middle of the fight, we came." Xiao Se kept looking at the sedan and said casually.
"Then what?" Lei Wujie was still confused.
"Then they discovered, wow, no need to fight, the big fish that should come has already arrived!" Xiao Se said angrily.
"Big fish? You mean us?" Lei Wujie suddenly realized.
"No!" Xiao Se grabbed Lei Wujie and jumped to the edge to avoid Wu Xin from a distance, "It's just him who's the big fish!"
Wu Xin smiled and puffed up his sleeves. He looked less like a monk who was eating fast and worshiping Buddha, and more like an actor who was preparing to make his debut: "It's such an honor to have troubled the Great Superintendent of Palm Incense to come all the way to see me, a young monk!"
The two monks protecting the temple were shocked when they heard this and looked at the abbot at the same time, but the old monk still shook his head. The long-bearded monk was not surprised, he just looked at Wu Xin blankly.
"Sure enough, it's him..." Xiao Se frowned slightly at this time.
"Who is Superintendent Zhangxiang?" Lei Wujie, who was familiar with all kinds of hero stories in the world, was confused at this time.
"When Emperor Beili performs sacrifices every year, there will be four eunuchs standing behind him. One of them is holding the national sword, one is holding the imperial seal, one is holding the law book, and the last one is holding the blue and white incense burner. These four eunuchs plus the accompanying eunuchs who grew up with the emperor are collectively called the five eunuchs. . The eunuch holding the sword is responsible for guarding the palace, the eunuch holding the seal is responsible for handling official documents, the eunuch holding the palm is responsible for supervising the library, and the eunuch holding the incense is responsible for supervising the royal Buddhist temple. Everyone has great power, and they are all top-notch masters.
"Brother Xiao is so knowledgeable!" Lei Wujie called out Brother Xiao in a rare and sincere manner.
"I'm the boss of Xueluo Villa. There's nothing trivial in the world, and there's nothing in the temples that I don't know about." Xiao Se showed a bit of pride.
"Then why do the people around the emperor come so far?" Lei Wujie asked.
"The Eunuch Zhangxiang only supervises the royal Buddhist temple in name, but the position of Honglu Temple Minister in charge of Buddhist and Taoist affairs has been vacant for many years. In the past few years, he has been acting part-time on his behalf. All Buddhist temples in the world are under his supervision. I just didn't expect that this monk would be so important. Even the Eunuch Zhangxiang lives thousands of miles away. Rush to catch him. It seems that his identity is not just as simple as Wangyou's disciple." While Xiao Se and Lei Wujie were talking, the people in the sedan finally moved. Even when facing the powerful sword of the long-bearded monk, the people in the sedan did not move, but after hearing Wu Xin's words, he finally moved. As soon as he moved, the big man standing on the right side of the sedan also moved. He immediately knelt on the ground and raised his back. The man in the sedan, wearing a pair of purple boots, stepped off the sedan on the back of the strong man.
Xiao Se snorted coldly.
"Why are you humming..." Lei Wujie glanced at the man in the sedan chair, and suddenly understood that Xiao Se was unwilling to lose no matter what, especially his appearance, but the man in the sedan chair was good-looking.That's a little too much! He has a jade-like face, outstanding demeanor, and a pair of red phoenix eyes with some indescribable charm. Although the two patches of white on his temples still reveal his age, they add a bit of immortality to him. He holds a string of slender Buddhist beads in one hand, gently twirling them with his slender fingers, and holds a long sword at his waist with the other hand, seeming to be ready to draw the sword as if he is off the ground.
"Prince." Wuxin clasped his hands together and bowed his head slightly in salute.
"Don't call me Chief Supervisor. Only the one in the palace can call me High Supervisor." The man smiled softly and pointed to the sky faintly.
"Eunuch Jinxian." Wu Xin changed his title but remained respectful.
But Eunuch Jinxian still didn't buy it, and shook his head with a smile: "I'm not used to you being so respectful. Where is the evil monk in white who I had a good time drinking with back then?"
"Wine and have fun?" Xiao Se and Lei Wujie looked at each other. It's no wonder that when Wu Xin saw the drunken monk, he strode to catch up with him. He was so confident that he had met a fellow monk.
"Back then you came to me to drink, but this time you came to me to arrest me. It's different." Wu Xin smiled, his eyes cold.
"I have to obey the orders of that person in the palace, but I can still do it to save your life." Eunuch Jinxian walked forward step by step.
"Just walk there." Wu Xin said suddenly.
Eunuch Jinxian stopped and looked at Wu Xin with interest.
"Xueyue City, Jiulong Temple, Honglu Temple and even Tianwaitian came to see me along the way. Every one of them said they would not kill me. So your condition does not seem to be special." Wu Xin said.
"Have people from Tianwaitian seen you?" Mr. Jinxian's expression changed slightly.
"White-haired Immortal, Ziyihou. They are both long-lost people." Wu Xin said lightly.
"You didn't go with them?" Eunuch Jinxian's hand still touched the hilt of the sword.
"I still have some unfulfilled wishes." Wuxin's eyes looked behind Eunuch Jinxian intentionally or unintentionally.
"It seems that my choice to wait for you here was not wrong." Eunuch Jinxian smiled.
"Your choice is not wrong, but you must have guessed my purpose wrong." Wu Xin said.
"Oh? Aren't you here to kill him?" Eunuch Jinxian turned around and glanced at the long-bearded monk.
"Buddha is merciful, and monks should not act recklessly with murderous thoughts." Wu Xin said calmly.
"I don't want to fight with you." Eunuch Jinxian sighed.
"I don't want to either. It is known throughout the world that among the five great prisons, Grandmaster Zhangxiang ranks second in martial arts, even better than Chief Prisoner Zhangxiang," Wu Xin said.
"But you just said something wrong."
"Unintentionally ignorant, may I ask which sentence it is?"
"Xueyue City, Jiulong Temple, Tianwaitian, I am different from them. If I can't take you away this time, then I will kill you without hesitation!" Eunuch Jinxian's hand finally pressed firmly on the hilt of the sword.
"Okay!" Wuxin jumped up, his sleeves unfolded like flying wings, and his robes flew like a god, "Please bring out the sword, father-in-law!"
Eunuch Jinxian finally pulled out his sword. The moment he pulled out his sword, everyone in the temple felt a biting chill. It was a sword filled with frost. Wherever the sword pointed, everything condensed instantly!
"I remember! I've heard of this man, he is..." Lei Wujie suddenly shouted loudly. Yes, he had heard of it. He had heard of this man. This man was not only a figure in the temple, he was also famous in the world!
"The right hand kills, and with one strike of the sword, the wind and snow wither. The left hand is compassionate, lightly twisting the Buddhist beads, and the souls are destroyed and the souls fly." Xiao Se nodded and said, "The five eunuchs who were still young once left the palace under the orders of their masters and traveled around the world. Everyone is famous in the world. Yes, you have indeed heard of him. He is Fengxuejian Shen Jingzhou!"
